name: GetIMG.ai
tagline: GetIMG.ai is an all-in-one AI image platform offering text-to-image generation, inpainting, outpainting, and an AI canvas. It supports Stable Diffusion, SDXL, and fine-tuned custom models so users can create consistent characters and brand imagery. The platform also includes a face enhancer and background removal tool.
